patterns.note: Sections frequently use an asymmetrical two-column layout, often with a large image or illustration on one side and bold text with a call to action on the other, creating dynamic visual balance.
Headings utilize an extremely bold, condensed sans-serif font for high impact, contrasting sharply with a more standard, legible sans-serif for body text and smaller labels.
The primary brand palette is a high-contrast combination of off-white, deep charcoal, and a vibrant, almost neon orange used strategically for accents and calls to action.

The main navigation bar at the top of the page shrinks in height and becomes sticky after initial scroll, while a persistent 'New decafs' callout box slides in from the bottom right and remains fixed throughout the scroll.
The site uses a 'hero-to-problem-solution-proof-call-to-action' flow, breaking down the value proposition with distinct, full-width sections that often feature unique background colors or imagery.

technique_notes: The site employs a sticky header that transforms its height and background upon scroll, providing a compact navigation experience. A persistent, dismissible callout box with an email signup is fixed to the bottom right of the viewport, appearing after initial page load. Hero elements, such as product imagery, exhibit a subtle parallax or reveal animation as the user scrolls, creating a sense of depth. Other content sections likely animate into view using CSS keyframes, such as a fade-up or slide-in effect, as they enter the viewport.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, heavy display headings (~4-5x body text) create strong visual hierarchy, complemented by smaller, legible body text and uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on buttons and some card elements, otherwise sharp edges dominate.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and a more dense, grid-like arrangement for feature lists and product displays.

standout: The site's distinctive character comes from its irreverent, playful, and bold brand voice, consistently reinforced by the unique, cartoonish 'Wimp' character illustrations and the use of extremely heavy, impactful typography. It successfully combines a modern, clean aesthetic with a strong, memorable personality that avoids generic marketing tropes.
